articles.title: Champions League draw: Champions Paris St-Germain to face Manchester City and Aston Villa
articles.summary: European champions Paris St-Germain will face Premier League duo Manchester City and Aston Villa in the league phase of this season's Champions League.
articles.body:
European champions Paris St-Germain will face Premier League duo Manchester City and Aston Villa as well as five-time winners Barcelona in the league phase of this season's Champions League.

The back-to-back Champions League winners will welcome Barca to Parc des Princes, while they were also handed trips to Villa Park and Manchester in the draw for the league phase.

Premier League champions Arsenal, meanwhile, will host 15-time winners Real Madrid at Emirates Stadium, and have also been handed a trip to Bayern Munich.

Mikel Arteta's men, who were beaten by PSG on penalties in the final last season, will face Borussia Dortmund, Real Betis, Lille, Napoli, Azerbaijan champions Sabah and Slavia Prague as well.

Enzo Maresca's City will welcome PSG to Etihad Stadium and travel to Barcelona, where they will have a reunion with Spanish World Cup-winner Rodri, who moved to the Nou Camp in a £65m deal this summer.

City will also be up against another of their former midfielders in Kevin de Bruyne when Napoli visit Manchester, with Sporting, Porto, RB Leipzig, AEK Athens and Lens their other opponents.

Europa League winners Villa, returning to the competition after a season away, will host PSG and Dortmund and travel to Barcelona and Galatasaray.

Unai Emery's side also face Club Brugge, Fenerbahce, Viking and Slavia Prague.

Manchester United, returning after a two-year hiatus, will meet Bayern, Atletico Madrid, Roma, Sporting, Leipzig, Villarreal, Sabah and Como.

Liverpool, meanwhile, host Atletico, Porto, Villarreal and Lens while visiting Inter Milan, Brugge, Fenerbahce and LASK.

The first league-phase matches will be played on Tuesday, 8 September and the last round of games will take place on 27 January 2027, with the exact schedule to be released on Saturday.

This season's final will be held in Madrid on 5 June.

Arsenal: Real Madrid (home), Bayern Munich (away), Borussia Dortmund (home), Real Betis (away), Lille (home), Napoli (away), Sabah (home), Slavia Prague (away)

Aston Villa: PSG (home), Barcelona (away), Borussia Dortmund (home), Club Brugge (away), Fenerbahce (home), Galatasaray (away), Viking (home), Slavia Prague (away)

Liverpool: Atletico Madrid (home), Inter Milan (away), Porto (home), Club Brugge (away), Villarreal (home), Fenerbahce (away), Lens (home), LASK (away)

Manchester City: PSG (home), Barcelona (away), Sporting Club (home), Porto (away), Napoli (home), Leipzig (away), AEK Athens (home), Lens (away)

Manchester United: Bayern Munich (home), Atletico Madrid (away), Roma (home), Sporting Club (away), Leipzig (home), Villarreal (away), Sabah (home), Como (away)

Each of the 36 teams plays eight different teams - four at home and four away - in the league phase.

Teams who finish in the top eight automatically qualify for the last 16, while those placing ninth to 24th will compete in a two-legged knockout play-off for the chance to join them.

Sides who finish 25th or lower will be eliminated, and will not drop into the Europa League.

Last season, eventual runners-up Arsenal topped the league phase standings with 24 points after eight wins from as many matches.

Liverpool were third - behind second-placed Bayern Munich - with 18 points while Tottenham finished one point behind in fourth.

Chelsea and Manchester City also qualified directly for the last 16 after finishing sixth and eighth respectively while Newcastle finished 12th.

Chelsea, Manchester City, Newcastle and Spurs were knocked out in the last 16 last season while Liverpool were beaten in the quarter-finals by PSG, who also edged Arsenal in the final for their second consecutive title.

articles.title: El Spotify Camp Nou se inunda de banderas esteladas
articles.standfirst: Por iniciativa de varias asociaciones catalanistas y de muchos aficionados
articles.summary: Por iniciativa de varias asociaciones catalanistas y de muchos aficionados
articles.body: El Spotify Camp Nou se inundó, como se esperaba, de banderas esteladas. La enseña independentista fue la protagonista antes del inicio del encuentro entre el Barcelona y el Athletic, el primer partido de los culés ante su grada de la temporada 26-27. La exaltación de la insignia es consecuencia de la carga policial que sufrieron algunos seguidores el pasado fin de semana en Elche por lucirla y a iniciativa de varias asociaciones catalanistas y de miles de seguidores culés. Como anunció Joan Laporta ayer miércoles, no hubo homenaje a los campeones del mundo para evitar conflictos y posibles enfrentamientos. Pero sí hubo un acto de exaltación de la bandera estelada. No fue una acción organizada ni promovida por el Barça, pero la entidad catalana secundó la propuesta, como expresó el presidente azulgrana. Cuando saltaron los jugadores al terreno de juego, los seguidores alzaron las banderas y las cartulinas, mientras cantaban el himno culé. El estadio azulgrana expresó su catalanidad. El encuentro empezó con una fiesta del sentimiento independentista. "Las imágenes son espeluznantes y muy claras. Una vez reconfirmados los hechos, pedimos que se apliquen las sanciones y los castigos pertinentes", comentó Laporta ante la agresión que sufrieron algunos seguidores, especialmente un menor, por parte de algunos agentes policiales en Elche. "Que el acto sirva para que los culés y los catalanes podamos ir con la estelada sin que corra peligro nuestra integridad física y que este elemento deje de estar estigmatizado por las fuerzas de seguridad y el orden público del Estado", añadió el mandatario azulgrana. Fueron, sobre todo, la ANC (Asamblea Nacional Catalana) y Ómnium Cultural, quienes alentaron a los seguidores culés a llevar y ondear esta noche, en el cruce contra el Athletic, la bandera independentista, y repartieron más de 10.000 en los alrededores del feudo azulgrana.

articles.title: Aaron Ochoa se rompe y estará de baja alrededor de tres meses
articles.standfirst: El joven atacante tiene una lesión en el menisco
articles.summary: El joven atacante tiene una lesión en el menisco
articles.body: El Málaga CF pierde durante un tiempo a una de sus grandes apuestas de futuro. Aarón Ochoa tendrá que pasar por el quirófano el próximo lunes en Madrid para solucionar la lesión que arrastra en el menisco externo de su rodilla derecha. El centrocampista será intervenido después de que las molestias no hayan remitido y el diagnóstico haya terminado siendo más serio de lo previsto. El futbolista ya estaba fuera de la dinámica del primer equipo desde el inicio de la temporada. Ochoa comenzó a arrastrar problemas durante la pretemporada y, aunque fue incorporándose de forma progresiva al trabajo con sus compañeros, el dolor persistió. De hecho, Juanfran Funes llegó a deslizar antes del estreno ante el Atlético de Madrid que el canterano podría haber tenido minutos de no mediar su sanción. Finalmente, la evolución de la lesión ha obligado a tomar una decisión más drástica. La baja supone un golpe para los planes de Juanfran Funes. El técnico tenía en Ochoa, de apenas 19 años, una pieza más para su centro del campo y una alternativa con capacidad para ganar protagonismo durante el regreso del Málaga a Primera División. Su polivalencia y el nivel mostrado durante el verano le habían colocado como uno de los jóvenes llamados a contar con minutos importantes. Ahora, Funes tendrá que esperar para recuperar a uno de los futbolistas que más había ilusionado durante la pretemporada. Y lo hará en un momento en el que el Málaga todavía trabaja para completar su plantilla y busca incorporar nuevos efectivos antes del cierre del mercado. Los plazos dependerán de la evolución de Ochoa después de la intervención, aunque el escenario inicial apunta a una ausencia prolongada. Los servicios médicos estiman un periodo de baja de entre dos y cuatro meses, por lo que el futbolista deberá afrontar un proceso de recuperación que le mantendrá alejado de los terrenos de juego durante buena parte del inicio de curso.

articles.summary: El extremo dominicano estaba sin equipo tras salir del filial del Barcelona y firma por dos años
articles.body: Óscar Ureña se ha convertido en el decimoquinto fichaje del Real Zaragoza. El club ha cerrado su llegada como sustituto de Emil Hansson, que rescindió su contrato por un problema personal. El dominicano de 23 años, que estaba sin equipo tras acabar su contrato con el filial del Barcelona, donde jugó los últimos años, firma por dos temporadas. El pasado curso anotó ocho goles en 24 partidos en otra temporada marcada por las lesiones que le han perjudicado estos años. Y es que, su destino parecía ser Primera división donde debutó con el Girona, pero los graves problemas físicos que ha padecido le han impedido brillar más alto. También estuvo cedido en el Leganés y Cartagena. Ureña, extremo que puede actuar en ambas bandas, ya conoce a Ibai Gómez con el que coincidió en la selección de la República Dominicana y a Joaquín Delgado con el que formó el ataque del Barcelona B el año pasado. Ahora buscará olvidarse de las lesiones y ser el jugador que prometía. Talento no le falta.

articles.title: Pedri joins Arda Güler and Barcelona teammate in exclusive club during Athletic Club clash
articles.summary: Barcelona star Pedri has on Thursday evening added his name to an altogether exclusive La Liga club. This comes owing to his exploits in the Blaugrana’s late...
articles.body:
Barcelona star Pedri has on Thursday evening added his name to an altogether exclusive La Liga club. This comes owing to his exploits in the Blaugrana 's latest outing.

Hansi Flick's troops are of course currently locked in action on the domestic front. After making short work of Elche on opening day, Barca have welcomed Athletic Club to Catalunya's capital for a La Liga clash.

As things stand, the evening's hosts find themselves headed for another three-point haul, boasting a one-goal advantage courtesy of a first-half strike from captain Raphinha .

The aforementioned Pedri, meanwhile, proved the architect for the goal, breaking free in midfield before slotting Raphinha in behind with a perfectly-weighted pass.

And as alluded to above, in the process, the Spanish international secured for himself a place in a four-man club in Spain's top-flight.

As revealed by statisticians StatMuse, alongside teammate Lamine Yamal , Real Madrid midfielder Arda Güler and former Getafe standout Luis Milla (now of Como ), Pedri is one of only four players to have racked up 10 or more La Liga assists since the start of last season.

articles.title: Rangers: 'Mortified' Derek McInnes takes responsibility for European exit
articles.summary: Manager Derek McInnes says he take "full responsibility" for Rangers' "embarrassing" Conference League exit at the hands of Jablonec.
articles.body:
Manager Derek McInnes says he take "full responsibility" for Rangers' "embarrassing" Conference League exit at the hands of Jablonec.

Rangers, who held a 1-0 lead going into the second leg of the play-off in Czech Republic, lost 4-3 on penalties on Thursday to crash out of Europe completely.

Derek McInnes' side actually led early in the shootout, only for Findlay Curtis and James Penrice to miss their final two penalties.

It leaves them without European football beyond August for the first time since the 2-1 aggregate defeat by Luxembourg's Progres Niederkorn in the Europa League first qualifying round in 2017.

And it ratchets up the pressure on McInnes after a hapless start to his reign at Ibrox, which included a Europa League exit against Jagiellonia Bialystok and a draw and defeat in their opening two Premiership games.

"I'm embarrassed with the performance," the Rangers manager said.

"The only people who represented the club well tonight were my staff and the supporters who were outstanding, getting behind the team despite watching what we all watched.

"I'm not going to make any excuses. Yes there's been a big turnover of players, yes we looked inexperienced at times but the responsibility is mine to make sure we're better than what we served up tonight.

"We're elite in everything we do in terms of preparation and the performance lacked in everything."

Rangers out of Europe after wretched penalty defeat in Jablonec

The stats back up McInnes' anger. Rangers had just over 46% possession during the 120 minutes in the Czech Republic, and just one shot on target.

They won fewer than 70% of their 16 tackles and committed 17 fouls.

"I can't accept, and we shouldn't accept, losing individual battles, duels, second balls, not winning enough tackles and just getting the momentum of the game going our way," the former Hearts manager added.

"I thought we looked young, inexperienced at times. We're trying to make some signings to help with that side of it but we need to do so much more as a team.

"We got what we deserved. If we'd won on penalties we would have taken it, of course, but it would only have covered over the cracks.

"I'm mortified with the performance. I know you can lose games of football but we should have enough in the building to take care of that tonight."

Rangers had won their two previous games - a 5-1 win over St Mirren in the League Cup and the 1-0 victory against Jablonec at Ibrox - after drawing at Dundee United and losing at home to Hibernian in their opening two Premiership matches.

But McInnes feels this latest result may set them back.

"We went into this game scrambling for some sort of confidence, some positivity," he said. "But I just thought the team that deserved to go through went through tonight and that's hard for me to take."

articles.title: Official | Augsburg’s Keven Schlotterbeck completes Southampton switch
articles.summary: Southampton have officially completed the signing of FC Augsburg centre-back Keven Schlotterbeck. The 29-year-old departs the Bundesliga one year before the...
articles.body:
Southampton have officially completed the signing of FC Augsburg centre-back Keven Schlotterbeck . The 29-year-old departs the Bundesliga one year before the expiration of his contract and embarks upon the first foreign adventure of his professional career. While Augsburg officially declined to disclose the financial terms, Kicker reports that Southampton have paid a fixed fee of approximately €3.85m.

The move comes somewhat unexpectedly given the defender's recently improved prospects in Augsburg . Schlotterbeck captained Manuel Baum's side and played the full 90 minutes in their 2-0 DFB-Pokal victory over Energie Cottbus. Get German Football News' 2026/27 Augsburg tactical preview projected Schlotterbeck as the established left-sided member of Baum's back three alongside Chrislain Matsima and Noahkai Banks .

Schlotterbeck fulfills ambition to play abroad

The former Freiburg academy defender had repeatedly spoken about wanting to experience football outside Germany before the conclusion of his career. Schlotterbeck developed into a Bundesliga professional at Freiburg before spending the 2019/20 campaign on loan at Union Berlin . Two productive loan spells at Bochum later helped establish him as a reliable Bundesliga centre-back. Augsburg signed Schlotterbeck permanently from Freiburg for approximately €2.5m in summer 2024.

The defender quickly became an important player for the Fuggerstädter, ultimately making 49 competitive appearances while registering three goals and three assists. His first Augsburg campaign also underlined an attacking threat that had already become apparent during his time at Bochum. A muscle injury interrupted an excellent start before competition for places eventually intensified.

GGFN reported on Köln's interest in Schlotterbeck last summer after Zesiger displaced him from the starting XI. Schlotterbeck instead remained in Bavaria and fought his way back into the side during pre-season. He subsequently developed into one of Augsburg's senior leaders and wore the captain's armband on multiple occasions.

Southampton sporting director Johannes Spors specifically identified Schlotterbeck's leadership as part of the attraction. The Saints had been seeking an experienced left-footed centre-back and believe the German's physical and technical qualities fit their needs.

Schlotterbeck joins a Southampton side coached by German trainer Tonda Eckert. The Championship club remain focused on returning to the Premier League after narrowly missing promotion last season.

Statements on Keven Schlotterbeck's Southampton move

"Keven always communicated openly to us that he wanted to take the step abroad at some point in his career," Augsburg sporting director Benni Weber said. "He now has the opportunity to fulfil that wish in England while also building a long-term sporting perspective there. Our discussions with him were always open and very appreciative. Keven served the team completely until his final day and always gave everything for FCA. We expressly thank him for that."

"We had identified the need for a left-footed centre-back and Keven fulfils that requirement while also bringing plenty of experience," Southampton sporting director Johannes Spors said. "His physical and technical qualities are complemented by his mentality. He is a real leader."

"I'm happy and delighted," Schlotterbeck said following his Southampton unveiling. "I have big ambitions. Even though leaving isn't easy for me, moving to England is a very exciting and appealing challenge. I have repeatedly stressed that I wanted to gain experience abroad during my career. I'm very grateful to FC Augsburg for our time together and for the many special moments I was able to experience here."
